content:
You will be given an argumentation and will be asked about to annotate a specified sentence from it for it's argument components.
Annotate the argumentative parts of specified sentence with their argumentative roles such as pro (proponent), opp (opponent) using xml like tags to indicate start and end of a component.
Note that most of the sentences are argumentative. Annotate as much as you can.

Video games, namely FIFA in my case, can fascinate young people for hours more intensively and emotionally than any sport in the world! It would be fair to make them into an Olympic event. Perhaps it is less thrilling for a spectator than for the player, but also for contemporary Olympic events, I recall curling and 50km cross-country skiing, you have to be more than a freak to follow those more properly than only in the roundup of highlights. Plus the hurdle to make video games Olympic events is minimal, as you don't even need doping tests, only a neutral console. And many a video game is physically and particularly mentally more demanding, when I think of the last FIFA tournament's final, than kicking a ball 20 metres.
What argument components exists in sentence " Perhaps it is less thrilling for a spectator than for the player, but also for contemporary Olympic events, I recall curling and 50km cross-country skiing, you have to be more than a freak to follow those more properly than only in the roundup of highlights" from the above dispute? Please annotate the constituing words.

<opp>Perhaps it is less thrilling for a spectator than for the player,</opp> <pro>but also for contemporary Olympic events, I recall curling and 50km cross-country skiing, you have to be more than a freak to follow those more properly than only in the roundup of highlights</pro>
